purpose: Migrate all 12 recordEpoch call sites from the groups.length proxy (readEpoch) to the real MLS epoch hook (getGroupEpochHook), update recordEpoch to accept number|null and skip on null, and implement assertS6 with the actual non-decreasing sequence assertion.
test_targets: AC-S6-1: all 12 recordEpoch sites use getGroupEpochHook
AC-S6-2: assertS6 walks epochSequenceA and epochSequenceB asserting non-decreasing
AC-S6-3: recordEpoch accepts number|null and skips on null
AC-S6-4: deliberate regression deferred to S8
